description: After a Read or Bash call that read a vault note, adds the note's stale and drift findings next to the result (also when the command exits non-zero). Silent when there are none; never blocks.

hooks.command: command -v wikiknit >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec wikiknit hook read
